create_multinomial: create a Multinomial distribution with total_count and probs or logits parameters
sample_multinomial: sample from a Multinomial distribution with an optional sample_shape
compute_log_prob_multinomial: compute the log probability of a value under a Multinomial distribution
get_multinomial_mean: get the mean of a Multinomial distribution
get_multinomial_variance: get the variance of a Multinomial distribution
